description: This file contains shell script functions and logic for handling firmware upgrades on Buffalo devices, including image validation, partition management, and upgrade procedures.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image, checks its format, and verifies compatibility with the device.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for TRX + UBI formatted images, including erasing and writing the firmware to the device.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for performing the firmware upgrade based on image type, delegating to specific functions.
